reasons: The concept was re-read at commit 60577ee014 (2026-11-13), which landed during this judging. It deleted the paved-strip leaf, folded the banks-heat leaf into furnacebeast_warms and added dry-ash wording, so those two leaves have no rows. Status of the 2026-11-06 verdict's six gaps: the venom, giant-size, dome-control, showcase-exercises and three_skies-sheet gaps are fixed. The ash-dusting scene exists but counts a deleted def. The worldgen gap is settled by his card, but the sheet contradicts itself and no check is named. Every scene keeps an asserted start, a control with rules_out and a restore. The main problem is that the code moved under the concept on 2026-11-08 (8fb9f7f2b6): the loose-ash filth that every ash oracle counts was deleted, and unlisted behaviour shipped. The 2026-11-13 edits updated the tree's claims without updating the scenes or re-running the exam. The sc_furnace_bed rewrite also dropped the only heat-immunity read.
